title: Audit run header (audit.json)
description: The first file of every run. It names the site, its URL and the main goal the audit is judged against. The report builder rejects any field not listed here.

site.description: Display name of the site or business.

url.description: Address of the audited site, for example https://example.com.

primary_goal.description: What the site is meant to achieve. Later findings are judged against it.

tagline.description: Optional short line shown under the site name. May be empty.

slug.description: Optional folder name part (audit-<slug>): lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. When empty or missing, the builder derives it from the URL.

date.description: Optional audit date as YYYY-MM-DD. When empty or missing, the builder uses today. It must also be a real calendar date, which a schema cannot check.

mode.description: extended means browser scans were available; basic means they were not. When empty or missing, the builder picks extended if any scan file exists.

logo.description: Optional file name of an image saved in the run folder. Leave it out if there is none.
